title: 3.2 I, You, and We
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to give a name and limited age/origin/job information and describe simple possession.
goal: Connect speaker roles to I, you, and we and use the fixed frames I am, you are, and we are with known actions.
grammar_function: I am; you are; we are. Speaker perspective is shown explicitly, not inferred from an ordinary third-person picture.
prerequisite: 3.1 greeting/name chunks and Unit 1 action sentences with is/are.
speaking_outcome: Repeat I am..., You are..., and We are... action sentences with correct be forms.

cards.pedagogy_note: self-pointing gesture and conversational gaze identify the speaker
gaze, body direction, and Ana's gesture toward Luis identify the addressee
only the complete We + talking sentence matches the marked speaker group and action
text hidden; self-pointing gesture remains visible
perspective and action application without subset-true distractors
